transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time to meet. As you know, we have a student returning next Monday after a short suspension related to repeated peer conflicts, and I need to review and approve their re-entry behavior and safety plan before they come back. I've reviewed the draft, which currently lists ordinary cafeteria lunch, one weekly counselor check-in, the school's general emergency response procedure, and an in-person family conference. Before I make a decision on this plan, I'd like to hear from each of you. Could the student's teacher, counselor, and family liaison please share any relevant observations, records, or family arrangements that might help me assess whether this plan is sufficient?

I should also note that my observation log has not yet been attached to the re-entry draft, so this information isn't reflected in the current plan.
